# Thunderbird Calendar edit-Save Bugzilla planning and date-picker research

Trial checks must include screen reader, keyboard model, forced colors/high contrast, RTL, timezone, and stable popup height. Vanilla Calendar Pro needs particular scrutiny because visible-edge arrow navigation lacks Home/End/Page Up/Page Down, it renders only needed week rows, and inspected CSS had no explicit `forced-colors`/`prefers-contrast` selectors. [Task 2]

Scope: calendar.
